on Thursday that it had renewed its normal course issuer bid, or NCIB, effective September 21, to repurchase up to 8.85M common shares, or about 4% of shares outstanding.
The authorization runs through September 20, 2027, with purchases at prevailing market prices in Canada and the U.S.
The company said the program provides flexibility to buy back shares if its stock is trading below the perceived value of its mining and corporate assets.
The renewed NCIB follows a 2025 program that authorized repurchases of up to 8.75M shares, under which the company made no purchases.

title: Silvercorp authorizes repurchase of up to 8.85M shares
